title: Exact presheaf realization of the Roos projection factorization
statement: Let $\mathcal C$ be an abelian category with derived category $D(\mathcal C)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category] admitting countable products, and let $D,S$ be categories. Let $G:\mathcal C\to\operatorname{Fun}(S,\mathrm{Ab})$ be additive and exact, with all $G\circ H^j(-)$ preserving countable products. Let $K:D\to\operatorname{Fun}(\mathbf N^{op},D(\mathcal C))$ be a tower-valued functor, $P$ its product functor, and $L:D\to D(\mathcal C)$. Suppose natural maps $p:L\to P$ and $\delta:P\to L[1]$ give distinguished Roos triangles [def-weil-derived-limit] for every object of $D$. For every integer $i$, the cohomology projections form a cone over $G(H^i(K_n))(U)$. The induced map $b:G(H^i(L))\to\lim_n G(H^i(K_n))$ is natural both in $D$ and $S$, is epi at every pair $(M,U)$, and its composite with every limit projection is $G(H^i(\mathrm{pr}_n\circ p))$ evaluated at $U$.

source.place: Tag 07KY, label lemma-break-long-exact-sequence, projection extraction in its proof

proof.text: The zero composite p(1-s) implies successor compatibility after every product projection. Apply cohomology, G and evaluation to obtain a cone. Its universal map b to the inverse limit has the required projection equations. Uniqueness after limit projections proves both naturalities.

Given an element y of the inverse limit, use the inverse product/cohomology comparison to lift its coordinate tuple to x in cohomology of P. The limit compatibility equations imply that H^i(1-s)(x)=0, as seen after each product projection. Exactness of the long exact sequence after G and evaluation supplies a lift z in cohomology of L. Its image under b has the same limit coordinates as y and equals y. Thus b is surjective, hence epi in abelian groups.
